scenarios: A reviewer applying the measurability rule sees these as post-sprint/one-time-transition criteria and flags them, though a concrete attestation is intended.

Plan quote: 'F20 updates the GitHub About description.'
ABSENCE: no named endpoint (e.g. PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}), no named field (`description`), and no named tool path (REST vs `gh repo edit`) appears anywhere in the plan or ACs.
Evidence class: Partially-verified — the GitHub repo-metadata capability exists and is standard, but the specific surface the plan will invoke is unconfirmed from the plan text.
findings.finding: F20 asserts it will 'Use the authenticated GitHub metadata API under repository administration rights' to update the About description but never names the specific endpoint, subcommand, or field it will call (for example REST PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo} with the `description` field, or `gh repo edit --description`). The external surface the plan depends on is therefore unverified at the endpoint/flag granularity T3 requires.
findings.location: Plan section 'Plan' bullet: 'Use the authenticated GitHub metadata API under repository administration rights for F20, then verify exact readback through the same principal.' and AC line '[operator-attested] F20 updates the GitHub About description.'
scenarios: An executor calls the wrong field (e.g. sets the homepage or a topic instead of `description`), silently violating the ACs that require topics and homepage to stay unchanged.
The chosen tool (gh CLI vs REST) requires a scope the 'repository administration' grant does not cover, causing a runtime auth failure only discovered mid-execution.
findings.suggested_fix: State in the F20 bullet the concrete surface, for example: 'Update the About description via REST PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo} setting only the `description` field, using a token with repo administration scope over HTTPS, then read back the same field through GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} under the same principal to confirm exact match and that topics and homepage are unchanged.'
